{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "ajtowns",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to bottom-to-top callback API and raised potential lifetime issues with raw pointers to structure internals"
    },
    {
      "login": "yuvicc",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested exposing witness stack serialization instead of a callback API (#36911)"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:7000400977",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "expose the witness stack's serialization instead of adding a callback type to the API",
      "quote": "Instead of adding a new callback type to the API, we could expose the witness stack's serialization, e.g. btck_witness_stack_to_bytes",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author answered that the callback was dropped in favor of array outputs and will review PR #36911",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:7001406224"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:7001406224",
      "status_by_quote": "The latest push drops the callback. The function now writes every item's pointer and size into two arrays passed to it."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4624098545",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "processing the witness stack from bottom to top treats it like a queue rather than a stack and is the wrong API",
      "quote": "This processes the witness stack from the bottom to the top, treating it more like a queue than a stack. Doesn't really feel the right API to me?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed 9d0f1d05bd to return arrays of pointers and sizes readable from either end",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4624575925",
        "rc:4624936766"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4624936766",
      "status_by_quote": "I switched to this shape in 9d0f1d05bd. I feel much better about this approach."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4637893873",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "passing back pointers to structure internals introduces lifetime issues if the caller keeps items around longer than the witness stack",
      "quote": "It also potentially introduces lifetime issues, in case the caller keeps `items` around longer than the corresponding `WitnessStack`?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained the kernel API convention of borrowed views via raw pointers and pushed 0b833469c1 to return copies in the C++ wrapper",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4639034578",
        "rc:4642779024"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4642779024",
      "status_by_quote": "the API went with raw pointers, where a const pointer is a borrowed view"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4639374101",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "hide raw pointers in an opaque owned Handle type or cache spans in the witness wrapper",
      "quote": "I think any raw pointers should be hidden in an opaque Handle type, and owned (or wrapped in `shared_ptr`)?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that raw pointers as borrowed views are kernel API convention and caching spans would cause allocations on every call",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4642779024"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4642779024",
      "status_by_quote": "Owned handles came up when the API was added... the API went with raw pointers, where a const pointer is a borrowed view"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "ajtowns questioned returning raw void* pointers and raised potential lifetime issues; author explained the kernel API's borrowed-view conventions for C and pushed a change making the C++ wrapper return copies.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "ajtowns to review author's explanation of kernel API raw pointer conventions and push 0b833469c1",
      "id": "c:7040647504"
    }
  ]
}
